transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Um, I'm here because I'm having a lot of trouble at work. I work in meat processing, and... well, I keep starting my tasks—like the sanitation steps, the batch logs, or the end-of-line paperwork—and then I just, somehow I always leave out the last parts of them. It's becoming a huge problem. I know my job completely depends on finishing those steps correctly, but I just keep missing the end of it all.
When you find yourself unable to finish these tasks, do you feel an internal pressure or a sense of needing to perform them in a very specific, repetitive way to avoid something bad happening?

No, not really. It's not like I feel forced to do things a certain way to stop something bad from happening, or like I have to repeat them. It's more just... I'll be doing the paperwork or the cleaning, and then my mind just kind of moves on to the next thing before I'm actually done. I don't even realize I didn't finish the last step until someone points it out later. There's no pressure to do it perfectly, I just kind of drift away from it.
Have you struggled with this tendency to drift off or leave tasks unfinished since you were a child, or is this a relatively new problem for you?

It's definitely not new. I've struggled with it since I was a kid. Actually, my mom still has some of my old elementary school report cards, like from around fourth grade... and they always said that I was bright, but that I needed constant reminders to finish my classwork and actually turn in my homework. 

I remember understanding the lessons perfectly fine, but I would just miss big chunks of the instructions unless the teacher stayed right next to me to keep me on track. So, yeah, it's been happening for a long time.

Aside from the difficulty staying on task, do you often find yourself feeling restless, having trouble sitting still for long periods, or acting or speaking before you have fully thought things through?

No, I don't really have that problem. I can sit still just fine, and I don't feel restless or anything like that. And I don't really blurt things out or act without thinking. It's really just the zoning out and not finishing things that I struggle with.
